title: Radio: V-2410 closed, V-2418 will not turn

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution 3. V-2410 is closed at zero seven fifty-eight. V-2418 won’t move — the stem is binding even with the machine.
The next valve upstream is V-2422 on Crestview. Closing that instead puts another eighteen hundred customers off the main.

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his 50s, frustrated, machine noise

instructorNote: Watch for the trade-off stated by street, and for the PIO told before any wider shutoff.

snapshot.title: Radio Call: Interconnect IC-1 Opened — Mill Road Booster Station

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.centerName: Riverside Water Treatment Plant Control Room

lines.text: Control, this is Field Crew 4 at the Mill Road Booster Station. We’ve arrived and performed the two-person valve operation on IC-1. The valve is fully open. The IC-1 meter FIT-631 shows flow at 2.5 MGD into Zone 2. The boosters BP-401 and BP-402 are now in AUTO mode. I’ve confirmed the manual override lever is now free and the HMI shows pressure rising. I’m calling from the site radio.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, steady, confident, with slight static on line

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject confirming the manual interconnect operation. The IC must log IC-1 activation on Form ERP-2; the TL must verify control system isolation remains intact.
